why: A fully loaded table keeps its last done/total badge instead of dropping it.

name: CSS badge rule draws nothing
why: The attribute is set but the ::after rule no longer renders it, so no badge is visible.

name: result writer does not refresh the badge
why: A hand-loaded row is written but the badge stays at 0/N until something else re-renders the header.

name: failure writer does not refresh the badge (overlap)
why: KNOWN OVERLAP: in the spec the failed row is answered first and the later successful writes refresh the badge anyway, so a missing refresh on the failure write alone is invisible. It matters only when a failure is the last write. Recorded, not hidden.
